notes: Task 6.3. Synthetic stories with invented entities where outlets disagree on a fact. contradicted: the claim states one side as plain fact (flag). conflict_attributed: the claim reports both versions and who says what (approve). supported: a fact every outlet agrees on (approve). Same format as judge_v1.

passages.text: Vexa Labs said on Thursday it will cut about 120 jobs in its phone division as sales of its handsets slow. The cuts will be completed by March.
Vexa Labs is cutting roughly 200 jobs in its phone unit, according to an internal memo seen by Northwire. The company is reducing staff because handset sales have slowed.

claims.text: Vexa Labs is cutting about 120 jobs in its phone division.
Vexa Labs is cutting roughly 200 jobs in its phone unit.
Vexa Labs says it will cut about 120 phone jobs, while an internal memo reported by Northwire puts the number at about 200.
Vexa Labs is cutting jobs in its phone division as handset sales slow.

passages.text: Halden Air will begin flights to Lisbon on March 3, the airline announced on Wednesday, with four flights a week.
Halden Air's new Lisbon route starts on April 14, according to the airline's booking system, with four weekly flights.

claims.text: Halden Air's Lisbon flights start on March 3.
Halden Air will start flying to Lisbon in April.
Halden Air announced Lisbon flights from March 3, though its booking system lists April 14 as the first date, Market Line reports.
Halden Air plans four flights a week to Lisbon.

passages.text: Orbis Motors has agreed to buy battery maker Kelda for $2.4 billion, the two companies said on Tuesday.
Orbis Motors will pay $3.1 billion for Kelda including debt, the companies said. The deal still needs approval from regulators.
Kelda shares jumped 18 percent after Orbis Motors agreed to buy the battery maker. Regulators must still approve the deal.

claims.text: Orbis Motors is buying Kelda for $2.4 billion.
Orbis Motors has agreed to buy battery maker Kelda.
Orbis Motors is buying Kelda for $2.4 billion, or $3.1 billion including debt, the companies said.
The Orbis deal for Kelda still needs approval from regulators.

passages.text: Vexa Labs chief executive Dana Morrow will step down at the end of the year, the company said on Thursday. The board has started a search for a successor.
Dana Morrow is not leaving Vexa Labs, a company spokesperson told Northwire, calling reports of her departure inaccurate.

claims.text: Vexa Labs chief executive Dana Morrow is stepping down at the end of the year.
Dana Morrow is staying on as Vexa Labs chief executive.
Ledger Tech reports that Vexa Labs chief executive Dana Morrow will step down at year end, but a company spokesperson told Northwire the reports are inaccurate.

passages.text: Officials said 14 people were injured when a Halden Air plane slid off the runway at Bergen airport on Friday morning. No one was killed.
Five passengers were taken to hospital with minor injuries after a Halden Air plane slid off a runway in Bergen on Friday, the airport said. There were no deaths.

claims.text: Fourteen people were injured when a Halden Air plane slid off the runway in Bergen.
No one was killed when a Halden Air plane slid off a runway in Bergen on Friday.
Officials put the number injured in the Halden Air runway accident in Bergen at 14, while the airport said five passengers went to hospital with minor injuries.

passages.text: Kelda reported quarterly revenue of $410 million on Wednesday, up 12 percent from a year earlier.
Battery maker Kelda posted revenue of $410 million for the quarter, a rise of 21 percent, the company said.

claims.text: Kelda reported quarterly revenue of $410 million.
Kelda's quarterly revenue rose 12 percent.
Kelda's quarterly revenue rose 21 percent to $410 million.
Kelda reported quarterly revenue of $410 million, a rise that Market Line puts at 12 percent and Ledger Tech at 21 percent.

passages.text: The Fenwick city council voted 7 to 2 on Thursday to ban delivery robots from sidewalks starting in January.
Fenwick's council approved a ban on sidewalk delivery robots on Thursday by a vote of 5 to 4. The ban takes effect in January.

claims.text: The Fenwick city council has voted to ban delivery robots from sidewalks starting in January.
Fenwick's council approved the sidewalk robot ban by a vote of 7 to 2.
Fenwick's council narrowly approved the sidewalk robot ban.

passages.text: Vexa Labs' Frost One smart fridge goes on sale on December 1 in the United States, priced at $1,900.
The Frost One will cost $1,900 when it launches in the United States on December 1, Vexa Labs said. A European launch is planned for next year.

claims.text: Vexa Labs' Frost One fridge goes on sale in the United States on December 1.
The Frost One will cost $1,900.
Vexa Labs plans to launch the Frost One in Europe next year.
